title: SWOT Analysis Adventure
meta_desc: Business Plans Adventure 3 — KS3 Business Studies on SWOT analysis for new businesses.
final_note: You learned SWOT and how to use it to size up a business idea.

concepts.def: Something you do well inside the business
A chance from outside the business

walkthroughs.body_html:
Strengths and weaknesses are internal.

  • Strength — a famous brand, great staff.
  • Weakness — high costs, slow website.

You can change these yourself. ✨

Opportunities and threats come from the outside world.

  • Opportunity — new trend (vegan boom).
  • Threat — new competitor opens nearby.

You can't change them; you respond.

Make a 2x2 grid. Be honest!

Plan to:

  • Use strengths.
  • Fix weaknesses.
  • Grab opportunities.
  • Dodge threats.

SWOT is the founder's compass. 🧭
